wallys.title: Wally's
wallys.description:
Mint pilasters, a creaky hanging sign and a wooden horse keeping watch from the roof.

Wally's sells secondhand shirts and swears every one has a story. Sign in here to pick up your Paperboy Hat!

Challenge: tell a neighbor your favorite ice cream flavor before you leave!

city_hall.title: City Hall
city_hall.description:
Did you know? Carmel City Hall used to be a church! The building was built in 1913 and acquired by the city in 1946 for $10,000.

Heads up! The Christkindlmarkt Investigation just wrapped --> check out our take, and share yours on the Local Internet.

post_office.title: Post Office
post_office.description:
Sue Johnson just passed her 10th year working at the Carmel Post Office. If you've ever sent or received mail, Sue's probably seen it.

We just posted our interview with Sue and her impressions of Carmel from her view behind the post office counter.

In the meantime, pick up a Paperboy postcard and mail a note to a friend!

maple_cafe.title: Coffee shop
maple_cafe.description:
Tired of walking? Maple Cafe has the best coffee and donuts in town. They have live music on Tuesdays and Thursdays and regularly put up art for sale from local residents.

Show them your hat and get a 10% discount off your order!

We'll also have a table set aside for Paperboy members to mingle-- come say hi if you'd like to meet some neighbors.

grocer.title: Carmel Grocer
grocer.description:
Joe's recommendation of the week:

ham, turkey, and cheddar on dutch crunch with little gem lettuce, pickled onions, and garlic aioli.

florist.title: Florist
florist.description:
Psst...

Share our secret password 'cypress' and pick up a seasonal, local's only weekly bouquet.

phone_booth.title: Paperboy Poll
phone_booth.description:
We're glad you made it and hope you had a great day on your Paper Route.

This week, we're asking Monterey Locals to share stories about their thoughts on Car Week. Love it or hate it, we want to hear about it.

Step inside and share your memories (good and bad) about one of Carmel's largest annual events.
